title: Agent cancel cannot stop a Flow that enqueues late (Video Edit describe, cloud edit, later legs/passes)
description: Found live 2026-10-11 (MPI-1036 Phase 4): cancel_generation on a running Video Edit answered NOT_IN_FLIGHT and the run went on billing a Pod; Fabio had to stop it by hand. Root cause: submitFlowGeneration (js/services/flowService.js) returns { queueJobId: null } whenever the job enters the queue LATER - after the describe step (MPI-1036, every Flow with describe:), after a cloud edit (MPI-918), and for a chain leg 2 / next pass (the ponytail notes at agentDispatch.js ~1110 and flowService.js ~535). agentDispatch._submitFlow stores that null in _queueJobs, so _cancelGeneration finds nothing. Hits outside agents (MCP/connector) AND Cosmo, which share the relay. Fix: return a live handle from submitFlowGeneration that is updated each time a leg/pass enqueues, plus a cancelled flag a pending describe/cloud call checks before it enqueues (then onCancel); agentDispatch keeps the handle, not the id. Every call site in one pass (root-cause.md). Test: tests/agent-generation-relay.test.cjs cancel during describe -> CANCELLED, never enqueued.
